description: List available stores, optionally filtered by cuisine and open state, sorted by rating descending.

latitude.description: Optional latitude of the delivery location (reserved for proximity filtering).

longitude.description: Optional longitude of the delivery location (reserved for proximity filtering).

cuisine.description: Optional cuisine name to filter stores by (case-insensitive).

open_only.description: When true, only stores that are currently open are returned (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with count and a list of store objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single store by its store_id.

store_id.description: The unique id of the store.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the store object; on failure (store not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the menu for a store, grouped into categories along with a flat items list.

store_id.description: The unique id of the store.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with store_id, categories, and items; on failure (store not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new empty cart for a given store.

store_id.description: The unique id of the store the cart belongs to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the new cart object with computed totals; on failure (store not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get an existing cart by its cart_id, including computed totals.

cart_id.description: The unique id of the cart.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the cart object with computed totals; on failure (cart not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a menu item (or increase its quantity) to an existing cart.

cart_id.description: The unique id of the cart.

item_id.description: The unique id of the menu item to add.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated cart object with computed totals; on failure (cart/item not found, wrong store, or unavailable), output contains an error message.

description: Check out a cart, creating a confirmed order and clearing the cart.

cart_id.description: The unique id of the cart to check out.

customer_name.description: Optional name of the customer placing the order (default 'Guest').

tip.description: Optional tip amount added to the order total (default 0.0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created order object with its items; on failure (cart not found or empty), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single order by its order_id, including its line items.

order_id.description: The unique id of the order.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the order object with its items; on failure (order not found), output contains an error message.
